sloka: हृद्गतं मे महच्छल्यं यस्मादार्येण धीमता ।अस्मिन्निमित्ते वैदेहि लोकस्य वचनीकृतः ।। ७.४७.४ ॥
transliteration: hṛdgataṁ me mahacchalyaṁ yasmādāryeṇa dhīmatā ।asminnimitte vaidehi lokasya vacanīkṛtaḥ ।। 7.47.4 ॥

translations.english: O Vaidehi, a great thorn resides in my heart because of which the wise and noble Rama has been made an object of public reproach in this matter.
translations.hindi: महामुनि सनत्कुमार जी राक्षसराज के वचन सुन कर 'बोले--हे राक्षसनाथ ! सुनो में तुमसे सब बातें कहता हूँ
